roles.role: Derate chain step: when the acceleration noise control fuel limit 0x80a28c (e2m 10A4 +0 NZFLLM 'fueling limit as determined by the ANC feature') is below the running derate minimum 0x80dec8 (105D +0 FSLMFL) it copies the limit there and stores 17 (move.w #0x11 at 0xb3c6) into torque_derate_fuel_source_code 0x80deca. Unsigned word compare, no gate.
roles.discriminator: The only limiter that reads NZFLLM and the only store of state 17 in the dumped ROM (so 17, not 21 as the old name says). Third call of the chain 0x30c3c, after the power take-off torque limit 0x2d9a8 and before the air fuel control step 0xc2a0. Its timing sibling 0xb4ce caps the timing with NZTALM instead of fuel.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - cm848_processProtectionLimits @ 0x0004280c has no ANC step and CM848's FUELING_STATE has no member 17; the ANC limiters are compiled out there (cm848_passCompensatedTimingToCombustionLimits @ 0x00017b54 only passes the timing through the ANC stage's variables).

roles.role: Group 2 (air handling) chain step: when the air fuel control fuel limit 0x80a8f6 (104C +0 AFFL 'fueling limit as calculated by AFC fueling algorithm') is below the group 2 running minimum 0x80dece (105D +6 FLLMAHFL) it copies it there and stores 16 (FUELING_STATE_AIR_FUEL_CONTROL_DERATE) into fuel_demand_minimum_tracked_state 0x80ded0 (105D +8 FSLMAHST).
roles.discriminator: The only chain step that writes the group 2 pair 0x80dece / 0x80ded0 and not the derate pair 0x80dec8 / 0x80deca; no gate; fourth call of 0x30c3c. It is not a 'shutdown minimum'.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_applyAirFuelControlFuelLimit @ 0x0000e0c4 - twin: the same three steps (unsigned compare of 104C +0 AFFL with 105D +6, copy, constant 16 into 105D +8), the same e2m record behind every operand, and the same place in the chain runner (after the power take-off torque limit, before the altitude step).

roles.role: Derate chain step: when the altitude derate fuel limit 0x80a922 (109F +0 ATFLLM) is below the running derate minimum 0x80dec8 it copies it there and stores 15 (FUELING_STATE_ALTITUDE_DERATE) into torque_derate_fuel_source_code.
roles.discriminator: Reads ATFLLM and stamps 15; no gate; fifth call of 0x30c3c.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_applyAltitudeDerateFuelLimit @ 0x00502af4 - twin: same compare / copy / constant 15 on the same records (109F +0 Altitude_Derate_Fueling into 105D +0 / +2), same place in the chain (after the air fuel control step, before the engine protection limit).

roles.role: Derate chain step: only while engine_state is 3 (RUNNING) and the flag 0x80ccb2 (11EA +0 WPLMFG 'fuel is being limited by engine warmup protection when 1') is non-zero, it takes the limit 0x80ccc6 (11EA +14 WPTQLM 'calculated torque limit of engine startup speed limit algorithm') as the running derate minimum when it is smaller and stores 33 (move.w #0x21 at 0x17146, Calterm ESUOILLM) into torque_derate_fuel_source_code.
roles.discriminator: The only limiter gated by the engine state and by a feature flag, and the only store of 33. Ninth call of 0x30c3c, the last one in the dumped ROM. Its limit comes from the warm-up protection state machine 0x16dd4 (rifle oil pressure threshold and oil drain-back timers, an engine speed table; enable = algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1 WPEAFG), which holds it at the maximum fueling 0x808004 while inactive. Nothing about high rpm.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - CM848's chain has no such step, its enum no member 33 and its flags word 18 no WPEAFG bit.

roles.role: Derate chain step: when the engine protection fuel limit 0x80d284 (10B1 +A EPFLLM 'maximum fueling permitted by the engine protection features') is below the running derate minimum it copies it there and stores 29 (FUELING_STATE_FAULT_DERATE, Calterm EPFDERAT) into torque_derate_fuel_source_code.
roles.discriminator: Reads EPFLLM and stamps 29 - not 18 (EPF), the state the trip statistics count as engine protection time. No gate; sixth call of 0x30c3c.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_applyFaultDerateFuelLimit @ 0x00509510 - twin: same compare / copy / constant 29 on the same record (10B1 +A Engine_Protection_Derate_Fueling), same place (after the altitude step, before the TSC1 limit).

roles.role: Starts both fuel limit chains from the fueling at 100 percent throttle 0x80d368 (105A +0 FSMXTHFL): the running derate minimum 0x80dec8 = it with source 19 (FUELING_STATE_MAXIMUM_THROTTLE), the group 2 minimum 0x80dece = it with state 40 (FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE).
roles.discriminator: Four unconditional stores and no compare; first call of 0x30c3c, so every limiter after it lowers one of the two minimums.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_initializeFuelLimitChains @ 0x0001f318 - twin: the same four stores in the same order with the same constants 19 and 40 from the same record (105A +0 Throttle_100_Fueling), and the first call of the chain runner in both. The scored candidate initProtectionStateWithFuelDemand @ 0x1f318 is this function's old name: verified.

roles.role: While the power take-off status 0x80dc26 (109E +2 PTSS) is 1, lowers the torque limit 0x80d338 (1051 +A TQDQTQ 'min torque limit in foot-pounds') to the power take-off maximum engine load 0x80400e (1268 PTMXEGLD, EEPROM mirror) when that is smaller and stores 34 (move.w #0x22, FUELING_STATE_POWER_TAKE_OFF_DERATE) into the limit's state 0x80d33a (1051 +C TQDQTQST).
roles.discriminator: The only chain step that writes the torque limit pair 0x80d338 / 0x80d33a - a torque in foot-pounds that 0x1c0d4 turns into fuel after the chain - and no fuel minimum. Second call of 0x30c3c.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit @ 0x0002a918 - twin: same gate (PTSS == 1), same unsigned compare of PTMXEGLD with TQDQTQ, same constant 34 into TQDQTQST, second call of the chain runner. The scored candidate checkProtectionParamLimit @ 0x2a918 is this function's old name: verified.

roles.role: Derate chain step: when the fuel system specific fuel derate 0x80decc (105D +4 FSAPLMFL 'fuel system specific fuel derate that is input to the core system') is below the running derate minimum it copies it there and stores 28 (FUELING_STATE_FUEL_SYSTEM_DERATE) into torque_derate_fuel_source_code.
roles.discriminator: Reads FSAPLMFL and stamps 28; no gate; eighth call of 0x30c3c (bsr at 0x30c62). In the dumped ROM the only store to 0x80decc is its start-up value, the maximum fueling 0x808004 (move.w at 0x30c90; dump 5888 = no limit).
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_applyFuelPressureFaultFuelLimit @ 0x0004279c - twin: same compare / copy / constant 28 on the same record (105D +4 FSS_Fueling_Derate), same place in the chain and the same ROM neighbourhood (this limiter, the TSC1 limiter, the chain runner, in that order, in both ROMs). CM848's name describes its common rail writer, so the shared name should use the record's own term (fuel system derate).

roles.role: Derate chain step: only while the datalink control mode 0x80da50 (10E8 +4 JCEGMD '0 disable 1 speed 2 torque 3 limit') is 3, it takes the datalink torque limit fueling 0x80da62 (10E8 +16 JCTQLMFL) as the running derate minimum when it is smaller and stores 20 (FUELING_STATE_TSC1_TORQUE_LIMIT) into torque_derate_fuel_source_code.
roles.discriminator: The only limiter gated by the control mode word (== 3); stamps 20; seventh call of 0x30c3c (bsr at 0x30c60).
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_applyTsc1TorqueLimit @ 0x000427cc - twin: same gate (control mode == 3), same compare / copy / constant 20 on the same records (10E8 Jcomm_Engine_Control_Mode / Jcomm_Torque_Derate_Fueling), same place (after the engine protection limit, before the fuel system derate).

roles.role: Runs the fuel limit chains: the initializer 0x1ce58, then the limiters power take-off torque limit 0x2d9a8 (34 on the torque limit), ANC 0xb3b2 (17), air fuel control 0xc2a0 (16, group 2), altitude 0xc742 (15), engine protection 0x196e4 (29), TSC1 limit 0x30c14 (20), fuel system derate 0x30bf6 (28), engine warm-up protection 0x17120 (33), then 0x45252 and 0x455c8, which lie above the dumped ROM.
roles.discriminator: Eleven calls and nothing else. It leaves the smallest fuel limit in 0x80dec8 with its source in 0x80deca (105D +0 / +2) and the group 2 minimum in 0x80dece / 0x80ded0. Called only by 0x1c152 (jsr at 0x1c18a) and only while the torque derate override bit is clear; the torque limit conversion 0x1c0d4 follows it. The other chain of the module, 0x30b34, limits timing.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_processProtectionLimits @ 0x0004280c - the same runner: same caller condition (torque derate override clear), same ROM position right after the fuel system and TSC1 limiters, and the seven shared steps in the same order (initialize, power take-off, air fuel control, altitude, engine protection, TSC1, fuel system). The lists differ by build: CM550 adds ANC, warm-up protection and two undumped steps; CM848 adds coolant overheat 46, torque management 45, 42, net torque 59, 61 and 62. By the strict rule that makes it a counterpart (cm550_runFuelLimitChains); as the same function of the same module one shared name fits, and CM848's 'processProtectionLimits' says protection without saying of what.

roles.role: Arbitrates the derated fuel and selects the final fueling in one pass. It fills the derate minimum 0x80dec8 / source 0x80deca from the chain 0x30c3c plus the torque limit conversion 0x1c0d4 (or from 0x803f2a with state 13 while algorithm_enable_flags_1_cal bit 4 is set), sets the requested fueling 0x80d332 / state 0x80d334 to the smaller of the governed fuel 0x80a8f0 and the derate minimum, then sets the final fueling 0x80d32e (1051 +0 FSFNFL) and final_fueling_state by engine_state: 26 stopped (fuel 0), 27 shutdown (minimum fueling), 25 overspeed, 23 user override, 24 engine brake, 22 cranking / jump start and as a floor in reentry, 11 for the low speed governor under a TSC1 limit, else cm550_diagnosticFuelLimitInterpolator - clamped between 0x80800a and 0x808004. Last it folds the group 2 minimum into the derate pair, latches the entry into state 11 in 0x80a908 and saves final_fueling_state_prev.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of final_fueling_state_prev and of the requested fueling pair and the only caller of the chain 0x30c3c. Nothing in it reads oil pressure or timing. Called once per pass from cm550_periodicTaskSet_fuelTiming (jsr at 0x1b5fe).
roles.cm848_counterpart: counterpart, not twin: CM848 splits the same steps over cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling @ 0x0001e5a4 (override 13 or chain + torque conversion, requested fueling, the group 2 arbitration and fold, the low speed governor under a TSC1 limit case) and cm848_selectFinalFueling @ 0x0001e22c (the engine_state selection with the same states 26 / 27 / 25 / 23 / 24 / 22, the clamp, the state 11 latch, final_fueling_state_prev), with the combustion reference stage between them and CM848-only branches (41 immobilizer, master / slave first).

roles.role: Runs the timing advance modification chain on 0x80d346 (103B +2 TSOI 'start of injection, timing advance used by each modification'): misfire floor 0x26af0, air fuel control increment 0xc2ee, cylinder pressure maintenance increment 0x12484, wet stack floor 0x34dba, ANC limit 0xb4ce, maximum limit 0x30b10, cranking timing 0x17cf0, then the undumped 0x49f32.
roles.discriminator: Eight calls and nothing else; every member works on the timing word and the timing state 0x80d348, none on fuel - it is the timing limit chain. Its only caller is the final timing selection 0x30b62 (bsr at 0x30b7e), which then picks the final timing 0x80de6a / state 0x80d34c by final_fueling_state.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - CM848 builds its main timing in cm848_calculateMainInjectionTiming / cm848_selectMainInjectionTiming; at the place of CM550's timing chain and final timing selection (just before the fuel system derate limiter in both ROMs) CM848 has only cm848_copyMainInjectionTiming @ 0x00042784.

roles.role: Timing modification step: while algorithm_enable_flags_32_cal bit 0 (misfire timing limit enable) is set and the intermediate timing state 0x80d348 is 0 (4D timing), it saves the timing advance into injection_timing_before_misfire_limit 0x80a270 (818E +2 BSTABELM) and, when the misfire limit 0x80a26e (818E +0 BSTAMNLM 'output of the misfire timing limit table') is larger, raises the timing to it, clears bit 0 of the timing increment flags 0x80d34a and stores 11 (label MISFIRE) into the timing state.
roles.discriminator: A floor (raises only), gated by an enable bit and by timing state 0; stamps 11; first call of 0x30b34. The other floor, 0x34dba (wet stack), has no gate and stamps 1 / 13.
roles.cm848_counterpart: counterpart, not twin: the misfire step inside cm848_calculateMainInjectionTiming @ 0x0004ae20 (raises injection_timing_demand to injection_timing_main_misfire_limit and stamps source 11); CM848 has no separate function for it.

roles.role: Timing modification step: adds the signed air fuel control timing increment 0x80de68 (105B +0 AFCNICTA 'timing advance added to base timing anytime AFC is limiting fueling') to the timing advance 0x80d346 with a floor of 0 (no upper clamp), then replaces bit 2 (mask 4) of the timing increment flags 0x80d34a (103B +6 TSSTIC) with the word 0x8000d6.
roles.discriminator: An unconditional add: no compare with a limit and no timing state stamp; second call of 0x30b34. Its inputs come from cm550_diagnosticTimingIncrementController 0xc2be: increment = AFICTA 0x808a6e and flag word 4 while final_fueling_state is 16 (AFC derate), else both 0. The sibling 0x12484 adds the cylinder pressure increment with a 0..1024 clamp and bit 3.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - CM848's e2m still has 105B +0 AFC_Timing_Increment / 105C +0 but their addresses (0x40a2e4 / 0x5c670) have no row and no code reference. The scored candidate 0x37f28 is cm848_monitorChargingSystemVoltageHighAndLow: unrelated.

roles.role: Timing modification step: copies the timing advance into 0x80aaa4 (1090 +8 TSAJ4DTA 'sum of 4D, AFC, user and coolant advances'), adds the signed cylinder pressure maintenance increment 0x80aa9e (1090 +2 CPTAIC, -20..20 degrees) with the sum clamped to 0..0x400 (1024 counts), then replaces bit 3 (mask 8) of the timing increment flags 0x80d34a with the word 0x80021c.
roles.discriminator: The only chain step with an upper clamp at 0x400 and a before-snapshot in block 1090; third call of 0x30b34. 0x80021c is 8 while the cylinder pressure maintenance code just before it (ends at 0x12482) is in state 2 (0x80aaa2), else 0.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none found - no CM848 row on 1090 +2 and no step of CM848's timing path adds such an increment.

roles.role: Timing modification step: saves the timing advance into 0x80dee6 (1077 +2 TSBEWSTA 'timing command just before wet stack modification'), then raises it to the wet stack timing 0x80dee4 (1077 +0 WSTA) when that is larger and copies the wet stack state word 0x8036e2 into the intermediate timing state 0x80d348.
roles.discriminator: A floor with no gate whose state stamp is a variable, not a constant: 0x8036e2 is 1 (label WETSTACK, the intake manifold temperature table won) or 13 (WTSTCOOL, the coolant temperature table won), set at 0x34cc4. Fourth call of 0x30b34; WSTA itself is computed by 0x34d52.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - CM848 has no wet stack timing code (only the e2m record 105E +A Crank_Wet_Stack_Timing, without a row).

roles.role: Timing modification step: saves the timing advance 0x80d346 into 0x80a29e (10A4 +12 TSBENZTA 'timing advance limit as just before modification by ANC timing'), then lowers it to the ANC timing limit 0x80a28e (10A4 +2 NZTALM) when the limit is smaller and stores 3 (label ANC) into the intermediate timing state 0x80d348.
roles.discriminator: A cap (lowers only) on the timing word - it does not touch a fuel demand limit; stamps 3; always writes its before-snapshot. Fifth call of 0x30b34, after the wet stack floor and before the maximum limit 0x30b10.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - the ANC timing limiter is compiled out in CM848: cm848_passCompensatedTimingToCombustionLimits @ 0x00017b54 fills the ANC stage's output (10A4 +14 ANC_SOI) with a plain copy and 10A4 +0 ANC_Timing has no code reference.

roles.role: Timing modification step: when the timing advance 0x80d346 exceeds the maximum allowable timing advance 0x808a74 (105C +6 TSMXTA) it saves the timing into 0x80de70 (105B +8 TSBEMLTA 'just before modification by max limit'), lowers it to the maximum and stores 4 (label MAX) into the intermediate timing state 0x80d348.
roles.discriminator: A cap against a calibration constant, not a computed limit; stamps 4; writes its before-snapshot only when it limits. Sixth call of 0x30b34 (bsr at 0x30b52), directly before the cranking timing step 0x17cf0. Timing only: no fuel demand limit, no selector 4.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - 105C +6 Maximum_Timing_Advance (0x5c676) and 105B +6 SOI_Before_Max_Limit have no row and no code reference in CM848.

roles.role: Commands the fuel shutoff driver: clears bit 5 (0x20) of 0x80bcfb (e2m 000E +2D DRFSEA 'controls fuel shut off driver, enable = FSO on') when the key switch bit (0x80bcce bit 0, DSKYSWSS) is off, or 0x80d34e (1091 +0 FSAPFSCO, shutoff asked by the fuel system specific code) is non-zero, or the engine retarder is active with algorithm_enable_flags_0_cal bit 6 (EBODEN), or engine_state is OVERSPEED with algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 1 (EPOSFSO); otherwise it sets the bit. Either write happens only while the driver's override priority slot 0x80bd47 is 0.
roles.discriminator: It writes one bit only - bit 5 of 0x80bcfb, as (5,a1) from the base 0x80bcf6; no fuel limit and no state stamp. Its entry is 0x1ca54 (move.l a2,-(a7)); the row vp44_canPinVp44StatusController 0x1ca5c is its third instruction (no reference to 0x1ca5c in the ROM), not a function. Called from the even phase task set (jsr at 0x1b63c) after the final timing selection. The slot is also labelled VPENPZ 'VP44 pump enable', so a vp44_ prefix is arguable.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - no CM848 code reads Engine_Brake_Override (flags word 0 bit 6) or overspeed_fuel_shutoff_enable (its struct comment: no reader in either bank) and CM848 has no fuel shutoff global. The scored candidate 0x6ab8 is mpc555_sciPollDuringEepromWrite: unrelated.

roles.role: Start-up initializer of the idle speed adjustment: with algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 0 (LSISSVEN, idle speed save) set it loads the adjustment 0x801a82 from the saved value 0x805f0a (1073 +0 LSICBKRF 'rpm added to LSG reference'), otherwise it zeroes both; it clears 0x80db08 (1049 +6 LSCIOD cold idle override flag), raises the idle range trim 0x803fca (131E +2 LSMNRFTN) to at least 0x808342 (LSMNRF) and lowers 0x803fcc (131E +4 LSMXRFTN) to at most 0x808344 (LSMXRF).
roles.discriminator: Runs once from the initializer list of mc68k_applicationMain (jsr at 0x287d4). It is the pair of the idle increment / decrement switch handler 0x26474, which adds the step 0x808332 to 0x801a82 and saves it to 0x805f0a. No fuel demand, no limit selection. The row vp44_initVP44StatusFlags 0x2659a lies inside this body.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - CM848's idle_speed_save_enable (flags word 12 bit 0) and idle_speed_adjust_enable have no reader in either bank.

roles.role: Start-up initializer of the trip information working values: clears the trip information engine state 0x80de64 (1215 +12 TIEGST), copies the saved integrated fuel 0x80619a (1216 +74 TIITFU, 4 bytes) into its previous-sample copy 0x801e82, and the saved lifetime and trip average loads 0x806186 / 0x806188 (TIEGAVLD / TIAVLD) into the running averages 0x801e92 / 0x801e94.
roles.discriminator: Four stores and no condition; called once from the initializer list of mc68k_applicationMain (jsr at 0x287f2). The periodic users are the trip statistics 0x304f4 (the two running averages - loads, not rpm) and the trip information task 0x306ca (the fuel delta at 0x308a8).
roles.cm848_counterpart: none found - CM848's trip counters are a different implementation (cm848_updateTripAndLifetimeCounters, block 8B6C).

roles.role: Empty function: a single rts. Called once from the initializer list of mc68k_applicationMain (jsr at 0x28774, right after mc68k_scheduler_init).
roles.discriminator: Nothing in the body to name. The code before it, 0x30b04, is an empty interrupt handler (saves and restores d0 / d1 / a0 / a1, then rte) with no reference in the ROM; both look like the stubs of a module left out of this build, and nothing shows which module. Missing: any operand. If a name is wanted it can only say 'empty start-up initializer'.

roles.role: Advances the two hour meters by one count: the engine run time 0x80ccee (11BC +0 CMEGTR 'time that the engine is not in stop state', 4 bytes) unless engine_state is 1 (STOPPED), and key_on_hour_meter 0x80bda4 (0004 +0 CMECTR) always.
roles.discriminator: Two addq.l #1 and one compare; the last task of phase 0 of the 40-phase executive (jsr at 0x1b974 in executiveFrameInterruptHandler), so once per 40 frames. It only reads the engine state. The next function 0x3452a loads both counters from the EEPROM mirror (0x803b3e / 0x803b50).
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_advanceHourMeters @ 0x00506780 - twin: the same steps in the same order (engine_state != 1 -> +1 to the 11BC +0 Engine_Run_Time counter, then +1 to the 0004 +0 ECM_Run_Time counter) and the same slot, the last task of phase 0 of executiveFrameInterruptHandler, in both.

roles.role: GLOBAL (now fuel_limit_shutdown_minimum, word): the running minimum of the derate chain - e2m 105D +0 FSLMFL 'smallest derate fueling value produced by the derate algorithm'. 0x1ce58 starts it at the 100 percent throttle fueling, each limiter lowers it, 0x1c0d4 lowers it to the torque limit's fuel and 0x1c152 compares it with the governed fuel. Dump 1236.
roles.discriminator: Nothing about shutdown. Paired with its source code 0x80deca (105D +2); the group 2 minimum is the separate word 0x80dece.
roles.cm848_counterpart: torque_derate_fuel_quantity @ 0x0040afac - the same record (105D +0 Torque_Derate_Fueling) with the same role; the five words of block 105D (+0 .. +8) have the same layout in both firmwares.

roles.role: GLOBAL (now smallest_derate_fueling_value_among_group_2_ah_derate_algori_0_100): the running minimum of the group 2 (air handling) limiters - e2m 105D +6 FLLMAHFL. Started by 0x1ce58, lowered by the air fuel control step 0xc2a0, folded into the derate pair and compared with the requested fueling by 0x1c152 / 0x1c03c. Dump 1236 with state 16.
roles.discriminator: Its state word 0x80ded0 already carries CM848's name fuel_demand_minimum_tracked_state.
roles.cm848_counterpart: fuel_demand_minimum_tracked @ 0x0040afb2 - the same record (105D +6 Torque_Derate_Fueling_2).

roles.role: GLOBAL (now anc_fuel_limit_value): the acceleration noise control fuel limit - e2m 10A4 +0 NZFLLM 'fueling limit as determined by the ANC feature' (NZFLAGEN: 'enable for fuel limiting of the acceleration noise control algorithm'). Read by the limiter 0xb3b2; set to the maximum fueling at 0xb632. Dump 5888 (no limit).
roles.discriminator: The fuel limit of the ANC family; the timing limit is 0x80a28e.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none - CM848's block 10A4 has no NZFLLM record and no row with code besides +14 ANC_SOI (ANC compiled out).

roles.role: GLOBAL (now high_rpm_fuel_limit_value): the engine warm-up protection fuel limit - e2m 11EA +14 WPTQLM. The warm-up protection state machine 0x16dd4 sets it from an engine speed table while the feature limits and to the maximum fueling 0x808004 otherwise; the limiter 0x17120 reads it. Dump 5888.
roles.discriminator: Not a high rpm limit: the table output only applies after a start, until the oil pressure timers finish.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (no WP family in CM848).

roles.role: GLOBAL (now high_rpm_fuel_limit_active): the engine warm-up protection active flag - e2m 11EA +0 WPLMFG 'fuel is being limited by engine warmup protection when 1'. Set and cleared by 0x16dd4 and its initializer 0x1709e; tested by the limiter 0x17120 (tst.w at 0x17136). Dump 1.
roles.discriminator: A 0 / 1 word next to the limit value 0x80ccc6; 0x80ccb4 (11EA +2 WPSSFG) is the algorithm-completed flag.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none.

roles.role: GLOBAL (now afc_derate_fuel_adjustment): the air fuel control fuel limit - e2m 104C +0 AFFL 'fueling limit as calculated by AFC fueling algorithm'. Read by the group 2 step 0xc2a0. Dump 1236.
roles.discriminator: A limit, not an adjustment.
roles.cm848_counterpart: air_fuel_control_fuel_limit @ 0x0040a158 - the same record (104C +0 AFC_Fueling).

roles.role: GLOBAL (now altitude_derate_fuel_limit_0_100): the altitude derate fuel limit - e2m 109F +0 ATFLLM. Read by the limiter 0xc742. Dump 5888.
roles.discriminator: Only the name's range suffix differs from CM848's.
roles.cm848_counterpart: altitude_derate_fuel_limit @ 0x0040a18c - the same record (109F +0 Altitude_Derate_Fueling).

roles.role: GLOBAL (now engine_protection_fuel_limit): e2m 10B1 +A EPFLLM 'maximum fueling permitted by the engine protection features'. Read by the limiter 0x196e4 (state 29); written at 0x18694 / 0x198f0 / 0x19938 / 0x1998a. Dump 5888.

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_ACCELERATION_NOISE_CONTROL_DERATE (CM550 only): the acceleration noise control fuel limit is the smallest derate.
enum_roles.evidence: Stored by 0xb3b2 (move.w #0x11,(0x80deca) at 0xb3c6) when 0x80a28c (e2m 10A4 +0 NZFLLM 'fueling limit as determined by the ANC feature') is below the running derate minimum 0x80dec8. ANC = acceleration noise control: NZFLAGEN 'enable for fuel limiting of the acceleration noise control algorithm'. Calterm ANCDERAT. EEC1 torque mode class: torque limiting (0xf8).

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_ENGINE_WARMUP_PROTECTION (CM550 only): the engine warm-up protection fuel limit is the smallest derate (the label reads engine start-up oil limit).
enum_roles.evidence: Stored by 0x17120 (move.w #0x21,(0x80deca) at 0x17146) while engine_state is RUNNING, 0x80ccb2 (11EA +0 WPLMFG 'fuel is being limited by engine warmup protection') is set and 0x80ccc6 (11EA +14 WPTQLM 'calculated torque limit of engine startup speed limit algorithm') is below the running minimum. The limit is made by the state machine 0x16dd4 (rifle oil pressure and oil drain-back timers; enable algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1 WPEAFG). Calterm ESUOILLM.

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_ENGINE_PROTECTION (CM550 only): the fueling is under control of engine protection. Tested only - no dumped code stores it (the engine protection limit EPFLLM is stamped 29 by 0x196e4), so medium confidence.
enum_roles.evidence: cmpi.w #0x12,(0x80d330) at 0x306b4 in the trip statistics 0x304f4: while final_fueling_state is 18 it adds 1 to 0x806192 = e2m 1216 +6C TIT3DQTM 'time the fueling has been under control of engine protection since last reset' (cleared with the other trip values at 0x3077a; dump 0). Calterm EPF. EEC1 class: torque limiting.

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_TOP2_SPEED_CONTROL (both firmwares): the Top2 transmission feature controls the engine speed through the all speed governor. Tested only - no selector stores it in either dump - so medium confidence.
enum_roles.evidence: CM848: cm848_runOperatingModeSpeedGovernor @ 0xea00 runs the all speed governor only in states 7 / 2 / 30 / 37; 37 and 38 stand next to the TSC1 states 1 / 2 in cm848_selectPowerTakeOffOrUserFueling @ 0x2bbe8 (power take-off bypass), cm848_selectCruiseOrUserFueling @ 0x411b0, cm848_arbitrateGovernedFueling @ 0x4043c, cm848_calculateDriverDemandPercentTorque @ 0x20860 and the cruise preset code 0x5251e4 / 0x525504. CM550: only the EEC1 jump table 0x32d04, entry 37 -> 0x32d5c (accelerator / operator, with 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 30). e2m 107A +2 ASRFST 'which algorithm is in control of the ASG reference' lists 2,3,7,30,37. T2 = Top2: T2HGSXDR 'TOP2 SPICER TRANSMISSION HIGH GEAR DRIVER SOLENOID', T2LGSXDR, T2NUSXDR, T2SISXDR '0 = 1 gear down or below / 1 = top gear', group TOP208 'TOP2 CALIBRATIONS AND DATA' (v64t6_s.e2m). Calterm T2SPD.

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_TOP2_TORQUE_CONTROL (both firmwares): the Top2 transmission feature commands the fueling directly (no governor). Tested only, medium confidence.
enum_roles.evidence: CM848: tested with 37 next to the TSC1 states 1 / 2 in the six functions listed for 37, but NOT in the all speed governor gate at 0xea00 (so it is the torque, not the speed, mode). CM550: EEC1 jump table entry 38 -> 0x32d88 (0xf8, torque limiting). Top2 from the T2 e2m records as for 37. Calterm T2TORQ.

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_TOP2_DERATE (CM550 only) - by the label and the T2 records only: no limiter in the dumped ROM stores it. Low confidence; otherwise it stays UNIDENTIFIED_39.
enum_roles.evidence: Only the EEC1 jump table 0x32d04, entry 39 -> 0x32d88 (0xf8, torque limiting, the class of every derate state). It may be stored by the undumped chain steps 0x45252 / 0x455c8. T2 = Top2 as for 37. Calterm T2DERAT.

enum_roles.meaning: FUELING_STATE_POWERTRAIN_PROTECTION_DERATE (CM550 only) - by the label and the PTP records only: no limiter in the dumped ROM stores it. Low confidence; otherwise it stays UNIDENTIFIED_36.
enum_roles.evidence: Only the EEC1 jump table 0x32d04, entry 36 -> 0x32d88 (0xf8, torque limiting). PTP = powertrain protection: group PTP_07 'electronic constants for powertrain protection', CM848's e2m PTP_Enable [TCEN] 'Powertrain Protection Enable' and its label 0x39 JCPTPDER. The enable bit algorithm_enable_flags_25_cal bit 1 has no reader in the dumped ROM. Calterm PTPDERAT.

enum_roles.meaning: NOT PROVED - stays FUELING_STATE_UNIDENTIFIED_3. The code proves only the class: a user fueling state in which the all speed governor runs on a reference speed supplied by another algorithm, treated like the pedal states for the driver demand. The reading 'progressive shift speed control' rests on the label alone.
enum_roles.evidence: Tested, never stored: cmpi.w #3,(0x80ded4) at 0xc982 (cm550_runAllSpeedGovernor gate 7 / 3 / 2 / 30, with the filtered reference 0x80a990 as for 2 and 30); 0x2dcb0 (power take-off bypass 1 / 2 / 30 / 3); 0xf796 (driver demand keeps the 4D fueling in 8 / 3 / 7); EEC1 entry 3 -> accelerator (also case 3 of CM848's EEC1 switch). The selectors run by 0x3458c store only 30, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, and ASRFST 0x80a98e (range 2,3,7,30,37) is stored only 30 / 2 / 7. PS = 'Prog. Shift' only by PSAGEN (106B +2 bit 5, group PRGSHFT2 'PROGRESSIVE SHIFT GROUP'), a bit no dumped code reads.

enum_roles.meaning: CM848 only: NOT PROVED - stays FUELING_STATE_UNIDENTIFIED_49 (label OFCSTATE). The code shows only its class: a final fueling state in which a limit holds the fuel below the governor's demand, like 16 and 19. No code stores it; this build stores 58 for the oxygen limit.
enum_roles.evidence: cm848_runOperatingModeSpeedGovernor @ 0xea00 only: with the deadband compensation flag it keeps the integrator in final states 11 / 12 / 16 / 19 / 2 / 49, and in 16 / 19 / 49 it computes the governor delta from final_fueling. e2m OFC_Fuel_Limit 'upper fuel limit above which oxygen is limited'.

enum_roles.meaning: CM848 only: NOT PROVED - stays FUELING_STATE_UNIDENTIFIED_50 (label AFRSTATE). The code shows only its class: an air-limited final fueling state, with 16 and 58. No code stores it.
enum_roles.evidence: cm848_calculateFuelPressureSetpoint @ 0x529f58 only: the setpoint offset slews toward its target while final_fueling_state is 16 (AFC derate), 58 (combustion oxygen limit) or 50 and the coolant and intake manifold temperatures are above their minimums.

notes: Method: every function read in the decompilation and in m68k.py disassembly; every operand resolved with e2m_block_addresses.py (v64t6_s.e2m for CM550, CHR_CC_11.45.01.07 for CM848); the CM848 twins disassembled with disasm_func.py; RAM values read at the declared width. Scratch: /home/linux/.claude/jobs/374b0424/tmp/w15/r93/scratch/F1/describer/ (notes.txt, ctx.py, ramread.py, build_result.py, result.json). CHAIN, step by step. CM550 0x30c3c: 0x1ce58 init - 0x2d9a8 power take-off torque limit (34) - 0xb3b2 ANC (17) - 0xc2a0 air fuel control (16, group 2) - 0xc742 altitude (15) - 0x196e4 engine protection (29) - 0x30c14 TSC1 limit (20) - 0x30bf6 fuel system derate (28) - 0x17120 warm-up protection (33) - 0x45252 - 0x455c8 (undumped). CM848 0x4280c: 0x1f318 - 0x2a918 - 0xe0c4 - 0x502af4 - 0x509510 - 0x427cc - 0x4279c - then 46 / 45 / 42 / 59 / 61 / 62. CM848 has the same small functions, not one big one: seven are instruction-for-instruction twins, and block 105D (+0 FSLMFL, +2 FSLMFLST, +4 FSAPLMFL, +6 FLLMAHFL, +8 FSLMAHST) has the same five words in both (CM550 0x80dec8-0x80ded0, CM848 0x40afac-0x40afb4). The same module in both ROMs: CM550 0x30b10 maximum timing limit, 0x30b34 timing chain, 0x30b62 final timing selection, 0x30bf6, 0x30c14, 0x30c3c, 0x30c78 initializer; CM848 0x42784 cm848_copyMainInjectionTiming, 0x4279c, 0x427cc, 0x4280c, 0x4285c initializer. SECOND CHAIN: 0x30b34 limits the injection timing (TSOI), not fuel. Its timing state stamps match the label list of TSTPTAST / TSFNTAST (0 FOUR_D, 1 WETSTACK, 2 USERCOMD, 3 ANC, 4 MAX, 5 CRANK, 7 USEROVRD, 8 STOP, 9 OVERSPED, 10 SHUTDOWN, 11 MISFIRE, 13 WTSTCOOL). OUTSIDE THE BATCH, seen on the way: 0x1c0d4 (cm550_FUN_0001c0d4) is the twin of cm848_calculateProtectionRateLimited @ 0x1e4e8 (torque limit to fuel, same operands) plus the reset of the torque limit pair to 0xffff / 40 that CM848 does in the caller; 0x1c308 is that pair's start-up initializer; 0x3452a (cm550_FUN_0003452a) is the twin of cm848_loadHourMetersFromEeprom @ 0x5067bc; 0x16dd4 (cm550_highRpmEngineProtectionStateMachine) is the engine warm-up protection state machine and 0x1709e (cm550_fuelTemperatureLimitingSecondary) its initializer; 0x26474 (cm550_engineModeTimingAdjuster) is the idle increment / decrement switch handler; 0xc2be selects the AFC timing increment; 0x34cc4 / 0x34d52 compute the wet stack timing; 0x30c78 (cm550_masterSubsystemInit) initializes the chain inputs. Rows inside another function's body: 0x1ca5c (in 0x1ca54), 0x2659a vp44_initVP44StatusFlags (in 0x2658c), 0x3061a (in 0x304f4). Other operands of 0x1c152 that are CM848 records: 0x80800a = fuel_demand_minimum (1052 +6 FSMNFL), 0x808004 = fuel_demand_maximum (1052 +0 FSMXFL), 0x808008 = engine_overspeed_fueling (FSOSFL), 0x808006 = engine_brake_fueling (EBFL), 0x80d098 = crank_fuel (CKFL), 0x803f2c = user_override_fueling_cal (FSUOFL), 0x80a908 = alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag (104A +10 FSLSSTFG); timing: 0x80d348 = CM848's injection_timing_intermediate_source_code (103B +4 TSTPTAST), 0x80d34a = injection_timing_increment_flags (103B +6 TSSTIC). SCORED CANDIDATES: 0x1f318 and 0x2a918 are right (the twins' old names); 0x37f28 (charging system voltage monitor) and 0x6ab8 (mpc555_sciPollDuringEepromWrite) are wrong. ENUM: 17 and 33 are proved by a store with its limit; 18 by a test with a named counter; 37 / 38 by CM848's tests plus the e2m meaning of T2 (Top2); 36 / 39 rest on labels and the EEC1 class only; 3 and CM848's 49 / 50 are tested but not provable to a feature. CM848 members above 41: only 49 and 50 are UNIDENTIFIED.
